semantic_reason: The issue reports a FunctionClauseError in Flop.Phoenix.Pagination.pagination_type/1 when a Flop struct has limit set but offset nil. The PR fixes the existing clause ordering/guard by replacing the clause requiring both limit and offset integers with one requiring only limit, resolving the reported crash. This corrects existing behavior, not a new feature.
